verdict.rationale: Ironclad's first-party docs cover the full webhook lifecycle. Webhooks POST to your URL on specified events, and you can create, list, retrieve, update and delete them via the API or the UI. Deliveries are signed, with a retrievable verification key, support API key, basic or bearer authentication, and failing webhooks are monitored and auto-disabled. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that webhook subscriptions work in practice, and an explicit catalog of the subscribable event types in the evidence.
